title: Kale Cake with Beer-Cooked Wheat, Walnuts and Caramelised Onion
subtitle: a steamed vegan layered kale cake
description: A vegan layered cake of wheat cooked in dark beer with caramelised onion, nuts and herbs, wrapped in blanched kale leaves and steamed briefly. It can be assembled one or two days ahead.

steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan, add the thinly sliced onions, cover and cook over low heat for about 25 minutes until soft, adding 1/2 cup water if they dry out. Uncover, raise the heat and fry for about 5 minutes until well browned.
Heat the remaining oil in a small pot and fry the coriander seeds, rosemary and quatre epices over low heat for about 2 minutes until fragrant. Add the wheat and fry for 1 minute, stirring.
Turn the heat to high, pour in the beer and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and cook partly covered for 15 to 20 minutes until the wheat is tender but still chewy.
Remove from the heat and mix in the dill, parsley, finely chopped toasted nuts and caramelised onion. Season with salt and pepper.
Bring water with 1 tbsp salt to the boil in a large pot and prepare a bowl of iced water. Blanch the kale leaves for 1 minute, plunge into the iced water, drain and dry well on a kitchen towel.

Place a 20 cm ring from a springform tin in a large steamer basket and line it with overlapping kale leaves hanging over the edge. Spread a 1 cm layer of filling and cover with more leaves. Repeat twice more to make 3 layers of filling, then fold the overhanging leaves over the top.
Refrigerate the basket for 30 minutes (it can be made up to 2 days ahead).
Bring water to the boil in a pot, set the steamer basket over it, cover and steam for 10 minutes. Turn the cake out onto a plate and serve immediately.
